items.source: Set the min-idle-time to limit the command to messages that have been idle for at at least the given Duration.
items.translation: 将 min-idle-time 设置为限制命令仅适用于已空闲至少给定Duration的消息。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source:
Set the min-idle-time to limit the command to messages that have been idle for at at least the given
milliseconds.
items.translation: 将 min-idle-time 设置为限制命令仅适用于已空闲至少指定毫秒数的消息。
